Argon diluted H 2S plasma was used instead of pure H 2S plasma in order to minimize the exposure of the ALD reactor to the highly reactive S radicals. The plasma was generated remotely from the substrate by radio frequency inductive coupling at 200 W. The substrate temperature was varied from 60 to 300 /C14 C. A standard ALD cycle consisted of 5 s precursor pulses followed by 25 s of pumping.
